title: The SOP Flywheel: Audit your documentation in 4 checks
caption:
Audit your documentation in 4 checks

Audit yourself against this:
1️⃣ Document the 3rd time — First is luck, second is a fluke. Third time — write it down.
2️⃣ Write checklists, not essays — Five steps beat five paragraphs. Doers don't read prose.
3️⃣ Record one walkthrough — Talk through it once on video. The transcript becomes the SOP.
4️⃣ Give it an owner — Unowned docs rot. A name plus a monthly review keeps it alive.

Score yourself in the comments.
